acceptance_rules_preregistered.band_rule: for every probability band with >= 30 test matches: |obs - pred| <= 0.05 OR the 95% match-bootstrap CI of (obs - pred) contains 0
acceptance_rules_preregistered.selected_model: the variant (A, A+Platt, B, B+Platt) with the lowest validation log loss per format x gender x innings; Platt variants scored by 2-fold match-split cross-fitting inside the validation year
